mapper.select:
SELECT id, account_no AS accountNo, location_no AS locationNo, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, management_name AS managementName, display_name AS displayName, address, latitude, longitude FROM common.location_mst
AND is_deleted = false AND account_no = #{accountNo} AND location_no = #{locationNo} AND management_name = #{managementName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO common.location_mst ( account_no, location_no, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, management_name, display_name, address, latitude, longitude ) VALUES ( #{accountNo}, #{locationNo}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{managementName}, #{displayName}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude} )
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(location_no) AS locationNo FROM common.location_mst WHERE account_no = #{accountNo}
